items.summary: Federal Reserve Board announces enforcement action against American Express Company to address, among other things, the firm’s failure to sufficiently detect and report certain suspicious activity related to money laundering

items.title: Agencies reduce regulatory burden for community banks, increase eligibility for 18-month exam cycle
items.summary: Agencies reduce regulatory burden for community banks, increase eligibility for 18-month exam cycle
items.why: Agencies issue rule easing examination burden and extending exam cycles for eligible community banks.

items.title: Agencies seek comment on proposed third-party risk management guidance and issue statement on community bank engagement with core service providers
items.summary: Agencies seek comment on proposed third-party risk management guidance and issue statement on community bank engagement with core service providers
items.why: US regulators propose new joint guidance on third-party risk management for banks.

items.title: HSBC to make 'deep, wide and brutal' UK wealth management job cuts in AI push
items.summary: HSBC is planning to axe up to 70% of its UK financial advisors as part of swingeing cuts to its wealth management business driven by riding use of AI, according to the Financial Times.
items.why: HSBC plans to cut up to 70% of UK financial advisors in AI-driven restructuring.

items.title: Singapore central bank issues risk rules on banks' AI use
items.summary: Banks in Singapore must seek an independent review of any forthcoming AI projects before implementation, according to new rules.
items.why: Singapore central bank mandates independent reviews for bank AI projects.

items.title: Wise to pay clients' tax bills after third-party software error
items.summary: Money transfer app Wise has contacted the UK's tax authorities over technical errors that led thousands of clients to pay the wrong amount of tax on their investments.
items.why: Wise to pay clients' tax bills following software error.

items.title: Mastercard to enable offline payments across Europe
items.summary: Mastercard is introducing offline payment requirements that mean that from 2027 Europeans will be able to pay during power and network outages.
items.why: New Mastercard mandate requiring offline payment capabilities across Europe by 2027.

items.title: FCA cracks down on finfluencers
items.summary: The UK's financial watchdog has stepped up its enforcement of illegal 'finfluencer' promotions, resulting in a 7,300% increase in actions between 2023 and 2025.
items.why: Significant regulatory crackdown on finfluencers with massive increase in enforcement.

items.title: Amex hit with $350m penalty for AML deficiencies
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), the main banking regulator in the US, has issued a $350m civil money penalty against American Express National Bank for deficiencies in its anti-money laundering (AML) and bank secrecy act (BSA) processes.
items.why: Major $350 million regulatory penalty against American Express for AML failures.

items.title: Bahrain central bank to treble tech budget
items.summary: The Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) plans to increase its investment in technology by threefold over the next three years as part of a plan to develop Bahrain to the region's primary banking hub.
items.why: Significant tripling of central bank technology budget.

items.title: Pepkor's $1.3bn fintech deal comes under shareholder scrutiny
items.summary: South African retailer Pepkor is facing complaints from directors and investors over a deal to merge its fintech arm with a rival company.
items.why: Major shareholder scrutiny and conflict over a large fintech deal.

items.title: ATO convenes snap meeting over credit card ban
items.summary: Australia's tax chief calls a snap meeting with business groups after the tax office faces backlash over its decision to stop accepting credit card payments.
items.why: ATO calls snap meeting following backlash over its decision to ban credit card tax payments.

items.title: Major share market float of Firmus in trouble as interest wanes
items.summary: The company is reportedly having to price its shares lower as it closed its books to potential investors abruptly overnight.
items.why: Abrupt bookbuild closure and forced repricing mark an unexpected IPO stumble.

items.title: Breaking: Hollard insurance fined $2m for handling of claim that destroyed home
items.summary: The Federal Court blasts Hollard's handling of an insurance claim which left a regional Victorian destroyed and uninhabitable.
items.why: Federal Court fines Hollard Insurance $2 million for claims handling failures.

items.title: Data centre operator Firmus pulls blockbuster ASX float after lacklustre demand
items.summary: Firmus searches for private funding as it withdraws its application to list on the ASX just a day after closing its books to investors.
items.why: Unexpected withdrawal of a major ASX initial public offering.

items.title: Trump strikes deal with Putin for Russia to supply diesel to US
items.summary: In an apparent reversal of Washington's campaign to squeeze Russian fuel revenue powering the war in Ukraine, Donald Trump says Moscow will supply diesel to the US.
items.why: Major sanctions and trade policy reversal with significant implications for global energy markets.

items.title: Union says cruise ship crews still open to exploitation under legal loophole
items.summary: Cruise ship workers will get some new protections following an ABC investigation, but critics say the exemption that left them vulnerable should never have existed and remains largely in place through to 2028.
items.why: New protections introduced for cruise ship workers following investigation.

items.title: Insurer underpaid hundreds of NSW accident victims in 'mind blowing' error
items.summary: The error was picked up by a lawyer of a crash victim who noticed his client's payment did not add up, not by NRMA Insurance or the NSW regulator.
items.why: Systemic underpayment error by a major insurer affecting hundreds of victims uncovered.

items.title: Critics warn of 'Santos-sized loopholes' in gas reservation plan
items.summary: Industry players say draft gas reservation plans are full of carve-outs that will let a venture many blame for rising prices off the hook.
items.why: Draft gas reservation policy contains contentious loopholes affecting energy market regulation.

items.title: BofA fined $1.21B over AML
